categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies src/node/miner.h, src/node/block_template_manager.{h,cpp}, and src/rpc/mining.cpp to manage block template metrics.
categories.rationale: Fixes inaccurate mining statistics reporting in getmininginfo and eliminates thread-unsafe global state. As noted in the description, 'the mempool fee estimator builds its own templates with BlockAssembler, so getmininginfo can report the fee estimator's template instead of the last mining template,' and moving these fields to BlockTemplateManager resolves this cross-subsystem contamination while progressing issue #33758.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes src/rpc/mining.cpp only to point getmininginfo to BlockTemplateManager instead of process-wide statics without changing RPC interfaces or handling.
categories.rationale: The change alters underlying mining state retrieval rather than RPC mechanics or wire protocols, which belongs strictly to mining per the rule that the behavior an RPC merely exposes belongs to its area.
